text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 01 · 星环领航舰桥.
Environment:  The silent navigation bridge of a civilian exploration ship, sculpted cream consoles with recessed amber abstract navigation diagrams, two empty linen seats, huge curved front window framing an immense pale ringed planet and its diagonal rings. Off-axis intimate bridge viewpoint, usable open foreground deck, deep space visible only through glass. Functional joins, warm brushed metal, understated optimistic interstellar engineering.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Redraw this as a STRICTLY FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL ARCHITECTURAL FLOOR PLAN, camera perpendicular 90 degrees to floor. Keep the same spatial arrangement. Essential change: remove ALL visible vertical surfaces, NO facade faces, NO furniture legs, NO window scenery, NO elevations, NO perspective, NO isometric. Walls as black filled strips; windows as three thin parallel lines in walls; doors as line plus quarter-circle swing; furniture as simple overhead rectangle/circle footprints; canopy/tree as circles; pools as blue flat polygons; stairs as parallel thin lines with UP arrow. Floor area/top surfaces only. White background, flat pale fills. No shadows, no photographic textures. Labels concise English, CONCEPT PLAN. Same location: 多题材场景60组 · 01 · 星环领航舰桥. For multi-floor show two separate small FLAT overhead plans labeled GROUND and UPPER linked by stair position. This is technical diagram not a scene illustration.
